title: Access the NSW Government API.NSW service
summary: This page provides information on accessing and using the NSW Government API catalogue for integrating government data into applications.
contact: To report a problem or make an enquiry, use the API.NSW online form.

faqs.q: Where can I find the NSW Government APIs?
faqs.a: The API.NSW catalogue includes APIs for licensing (in the liquor, property, trades, high-risk work and security industries), transport, fuel, water and strata.

faqs.q: How can I test an API before using it in my app?
faqs.a: Each API comes with documentation, sample code and free API calls so you can understand the API in a safe environment before committing.

faqs.q: How do I become an API provider?
faqs.a: As an API provider, you can publish your APIs, add details and endpoints, customize API call quotas, and incorporate Swagger to generate an OpenAPI document.
